title: Plan of Care Documentation Intervals and Payer Authorization Settings — Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services
content:
The rehabilitation department's documentation intervals and the payer authorization settings for **Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services** are fixed per tier as follows.

## Documentation intervals

| Tier | Evaluation required before treatment starts | Days after the evaluation within which the physician or practitioner must sign the plan of care | Longest period a certified plan may run before recertification | Treatment visits after which a progress report is due | Re-evaluation required on a significant change in condition |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part B Physical Therapy Plan of Care | Yes | 30 days | 90 days | 10 visits | Yes |
| Medicare Part B Occupational Therapy Plan of Care | Yes | 30 days | 90 days | 10 visits | Yes |
| Medicare Part B Speech-Language Pathology Plan of Care | Yes | 30 days | 90 days | 10 visits | Yes |
| Medicare Advantage Outpatient Therapy Plan of Care | Yes | 30 days | 90 days | 10 visits | Yes |
| Medical Assistance Therapy Plan of Care | Yes | 30 days | 90 days | 10 visits | Yes |
| Private Pay Therapy Plan of Care | Yes | 30 days | 90 days | 10 visits | Yes |

## Payer authorization settings

| Tier | Visits need the Medicare Advantage plan's authorization on file | Authorized visits remaining at which the business office requests more visits from the plan | Medical Assistance prior authorization must be on file before visits |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part B Physical Therapy Plan of Care | No | 0 (not applicable) | No |
| Medicare Part B Occupational Therapy Plan of Care | No | 0 (not applicable) | No |
| Medicare Part B Speech-Language Pathology Plan of Care | No | 0 (not applicable) | No |
| Medicare Advantage Outpatient Therapy Plan of Care | Yes | 2 | No |
| Medical Assistance Therapy Plan of Care | No | 0 (not applicable) | Yes |
| Private Pay Therapy Plan of Care | No | 0 (not applicable) | No |

## Notes

- The reauthorization figure is a count of authorized visits remaining: for the Medicare Advantage Outpatient Therapy Plan of Care, the business office requests more visits from the plan when 2 authorized visits remain. The figure is 0 in the tiers where it does not apply.
- The progress report interval counts treatment visits: a progress report is due after every 10 treatment visits.

## Illustrations (hypothetical dates and counts)

| Hypothetical situation | Reading |
|---|---|
| Evaluation on 3 March; plan of care signed on 19 March | Signed 16 days after the evaluation, within the 30 days |
| Evaluation on 3 March; plan of care signed on 27 April | Signed 55 days after the evaluation, outside the 30 days |
| A Medicare Advantage plan with 7 authorized visits; 5 used | 2 authorized visits remain: the point at which more visits are requested from the plan |
